assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production visual novel game animation contact sheet, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve equal square panels filling a 2048x1536 canvas. No gutters, borders, text, captions, numbers, UI or watermarks. Each panel is the same camera shot of the SAME SINGLE CHARACTER ONLY, waist-up centered, face at 30% height, same costume, proportions and detailed anime face in all panels, same background. Professional hand-drawn Naruto Shippuden anime frame with beautiful precise ink and rich cel shading, painted cinematic setting. No 3D, no chibi, no geometric icons. The character AND their physical magical restraint must be fully illustrated together, believable contact, overlap, shadows, dimensional fabric folds. No simple circles, ovals or line overlays. All twelve panels have exactly aligned framing for clean frame transitions. IMPORTANT GRID LOGIC: each ROW is a threat level: TOP ROW light restraint, MIDDLE ROW moderately engulfing restraint, BOTTOM ROW critical near-total restraint but face remains visible. Each COLUMN is rescue progress: FIRST COLUMN intact restraint; SECOND COLUMN visibly damaged/loosened restraint with first successful escape signs; THIRD COLUMN heavily damaged or retreating restraint with large openings; FOURTH COLUMN the character completely free, restraint gone, relieved expression, same background. Thus the bottom-row second/third columns must retain BOTH more surrounding restraint AND the damage already made. No other characters anywhere. Victim Hinata Hyuga: long straight dark indigo hair with bangs, pale lavender eyes, light lavender zippered jacket, worried but courageous. Background ruined Hidden Leaf stone plaza at ember sunset. Pain's gravity restraint is a mass of dark jagged stone and black metal receiver stakes growing up around her waist and bracing her arms, pinning her without injury, with dark red chakra glowing in seams. Increasing rows grow from waist restraints to forearm/shoulder restraints and heavy looming stone, downward pressure evident in her posture. Progress columns show luminous BLUE fractures through the stone and snapped receiver stakes, then large stone pieces falling away; freed column has no stones or stakes attached and she stands relieved. No rods pierce her body, no gore. Warm dusty amber environment and contrasting cyan rescue light.
